substrate.reason: A 50 m USGS sediment-thickness interpretation is broad geology context, not observed bottom rock or a fishing-pile boundary.

coverage_note: Big Sur limited preview: four bounded CDFW MPA polygons and reviewed Point Sur/Big Creek rules. Local NWS PZZ565/PZZ576 samples are available; Monterey tide/harbor and both buoy references are geographically distant. First rehearsal populated 101/144 SST, 57/231 chlorophyll and only 30/104 HFR surface-current cells. Original seabed data remain unqualified under the strict depth/uncertainty and substrate gate. No fishing points, areas, drifts or exports.
landing_note: No harbor or verified fishing position is established within this remote coast segment. Check trip range, refuges, advisories and exact MPAs before any voyage.
